<module id="float_multi">
    <description>32-bit floating-point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single-precision arithmetic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NaN">32'h7FC00000</parameter>
        <parameter id="INF">32'h7F800000</parameter>
        <parameter id="MIN_NORM">32'h00800000</parameter>
        <parameter id="MAX_NORM">32'h7F7FFFFF</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="counter" type="reg" width="3">Cycle counter for operation sequencing.</signal>
        <signal id="a_mantissa" type="reg" width="23">Mantissa of input a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_mantissa" type="reg" width="23">Mantissa of input b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_mantissa" type="reg" width="23">Mantissa of output z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_exponent" type="reg" width="9">Exponent of input a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_exponent" type="reg" width="9">Exponent of input b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_exponent" type="reg" width="9">Exponent of output z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of output z.</signal>
        <signal id="product" type="reg" width="49">Intermediate product of the mantissas.</signal>
        <signal id="guard_bit" type="reg">Guard bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="round_bit" type="reg">Round bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="sticky" type="reg">Sticky bit for rounding.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialization
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 3'b000;
                a_mantissa <= 23'b0;
                b_mantissa <= 23'b0;
                z_mantissa <= 23'b0;
                a_exponent <= 9'b0;
                b_exponent <= 9'b0;
                z_exponent <= 9'b0;
                a_sign <= 1'b0;
                b_sign <= 1'b0;
                z_sign <= 1'b0;
                product <= 49'b0;
                guard_bit <= 1'b0;
                round_bit <= 1'b0;
                sticky <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (counter)
                    3'b000: begin
                        // Extract mantissas, exponents, and signs
                        a_mantissa <= a[22:0];
                        b_mantissa <= b[22:0];
                        a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                        b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                        a_sign <= a[31];
                        b_sign <= b[31];
                    end
                    3'b001: begin
                        // Handle special cases
                        if ((a == NaN) || (b == NaN)) begin
                            z <= NaN;
                        end else if ((a == INF) || (b == INF)) begin
                            if ((a == INF && b != 0) || (b == INF && a != 0)) begin
                                z <= INF;
                            end else begin
                                z <= NaN;
                            end
                        end else if ((a == 0) || (b == 0)) begin
                            z <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            // Normalization and multiplication
                            product <= {1'b0, a_mantissa} * {1'b0, b_mantissa};
                            z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 127;
                            z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                        end
                    end
                    3'b010: begin
                        // Rounding and adjustment
                        guard_bit <= product[47];
                        round_bit <= product[46];
                        sticky <= |product[45:0];
                        if (round_bit && (guard_bit || sticky)) begin
                            if (product[48]) begin
                                z_mantissa <= product[47:24] + 1;
                            end else begin
                                z_mantissa <= product[47:24];
                            end
                        end else begin
                            z_mantissa <= product[47:24];
                        end
                        if (z_mantissa >= 24'b1000000000000000000000) begin
                            z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
                            z_mantissa <= z_mantissa >> 1;
                        end
                    end
                    3'b011: begin
                        // Output generation
                        if (z_exponent > MAX_NORM) begin
                            z <= INF;
                        end else if (z_exponent < MIN_NORM) begin
                            z <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            z <= {z_sign, z_exponent + 127, z_mantissa[22:0]};
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        counter <= 3'b000;
                    end
                endcase
                counter <= counter + 1;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
